video_title: "This is home for me" Pascal SIakam reflects on the trade, Lowry's retirement, and PS43 Foundation

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on his deep connection to Toronto and Canada
quotes.excerpt: I grew up here, this is home for me.
quotes.quote: I grew up here, this is home for me. One of the biggest things living in Toronto is getting to understand what the NBA is, a business. To me, this is a community that I felt something with. I created amazing things and to have something like the PS43 Foundation, we have to make sure that we keep it here and it keeps working. I think this is just a testament of that. We are all working, no matter where I am at, and to have an opportunity to come here, seeing the founders and the work that they have been doing, continuing to help the next generation with education, which for me means everything. It means everything to my family, it means everything to my dad. It is something that means a lot to me.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on his father's influence and the importance of education
quotes.excerpt: He loved basketball and that is something that he was passionate about, but school was way more important.
quotes.quote: He loved basketball and that is something that he was passionate about, but school was way more important. He was always helping kids in my neighborhood, cousins. He always did that and he thought education was the most important thing in the world. For me, when I knew that I had a platform and I had an opportunity to help people, that is the main focus and the main key that I wanted to focus on. To be able to do that right now and carry out his legacy, to me means more than anything.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on his transition to the Indiana Pacers
quotes.excerpt: I am super proud to be a Pacer and the stuff that we are able to do.
quotes.quote: It is all love. I have always said this is home for me. I love everything and everyone that I have always seen is always been love. Everyone is going in their own directions and I am super proud to be a Pacer and the stuff that we are able to do. We have great aspirations and I hope to continue to achieve more in my career. A moment like this, coming back here with the PS43 Foundation and doing things like that and seeing the love that you receive, it just speaks volumes.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on his relationship with Kyle Lowry and the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: He is the heartbeat of what when I came to the Raptors.
quotes.quote: We talk, so it is fine. I am super excited for him. He is the heartbeat of what when I came to the Raptors. I saw DeMar, I saw him, they showed me how to work, they showed me how to be a professional, they showed me the path that you have to take to be successful in this league. I will always be indebted to those guys just because they didn't have to. It is not like we had to be there every day and they had to teach me things, but just by watching them and the things that they have done, they do everything, how to be a professional. I have learned that early on.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam reacts to his first career assist from Kyle Lowry
quotes.excerpt: I would not be surprised. I mean he did, he was the general out there.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: I looked it up too. I don't know if you want to see the play? Here you go. This is your first ever bucket. It is crazy because I feel like you get better buckets nowadays, but this is the assist. It is not, here you go.

text_blocks.speaker: Pascal Siakam
text_blocks.text: Oh yeah, I mean I would not be surprised. I mean he did, he was the general out there. That is awesome. I like that. To Pascal by Pascal, that is tough.
